A review document is one JSON object. Unknown fields are rejected.

root
  version   "1"
  verdict   approve | request_changes | comment
  summary   1-3 sentences, 30-1500 chars
  ref       40-char lowercase commit SHA; optional, read by every anchor
  comments  array; empty only when verdict is approve

comment
  id           kebab slug + number, e.g. missing-context-2; unique
  priority     1-10: 9-10 blocks, 7-8 should fix, 4-6 worth fixing, 1-3 optional
  category     correctness | security | performance | maintainability | testing
               | documentation | style
  body         the finding and its rationale, 20-4000 chars
  code         optional excerpt of the problem; soft
  anchors      array of { file, line?, end_line? }; may be empty
  suggestions  array; may be empty

suggestion
  summary  what to do, one sentence, 10-500 chars
  effort   trivial | small | medium | large        — how much work
  scope    line | block | file | module | project  — blast radius
  pros     array of strings
  cons     array of strings
  code     optional excerpt of the fix; soft

{"version":"1","verdict":"request_changes","ref":"<40 hex>","summary":"The retry
loop drops the caller's deadline.","comments":[{"id":"dropped-context-1",
"priority":9,"category":"correctness","body":"c.do is called with
context.Background(), so a cancelled request keeps retrying.","anchors":
[{"file":"internal/fetch/client.go","line":88,"end_line":94}],"suggestions":
[{"summary":"Pass the caller's ctx through to c.do","effort":"trivial",
"scope":"line","pros":["Deadlines propagate"],"cons":["Callers see a change"]}]
}]}

refinery describe --lens=NAME opens any name below.

field  anchors, body, category, comments, comments.code,
       comments.suggestions.code, comments.suggestions.summary, cons, effort,
       end_line, field:summary, file, id, line, priority, pros, ref, scope,
       suggestions, verdict, version
check  document-unparseable, schema, id-unique, anchor-range-ordered,
       anchor-path-safe, ref-format, ref-unknown, anchor-file-missing,
       anchor-line-out-of-range, id-grouping, ref-missing, body-thin,
       vacuous-body, suggestion-absent, suggestion-no-cons, suggestion-no-pros,
       broad-scope-alone, broad-scope-no-cons, summary-thin,
       priority-category-convention, priority-flat, duplicate-anchor,
       duplicate-body, comment-flood
topic  effort-vs-scope, ids, tiers, verification
